title: 第五章 一阶兽核
novel_title: 全民原始部落，你搞军事基地？
content_zh:
吼！！

    一道低沉而狂暴的兽吼声骤然从树林深处响起，一道庞大的黑影正缓缓拨开密集的灌木丛，一步步朝着他的方向逼近。

    秦天原本还算平静的神色瞬间一凝，迅速朝着声音来源方向望去。

    虽然他早已心理准备，可看清楚的时候，秦天的心底还是忍不住掠过一丝心悸。

    那是一头通体发黑的野猪，至少有两米多高。

    浑身覆盖着灰黑色毛发，如同坚硬的铠甲，全身的肌肉更是夸张隆起。

    四根锋利獠牙外露，滴落着粘稠的口水，似乎下一刻就要将秦天撕碎一般。

    最恐怖的是它身上的气势，仅仅是站在那里都给人一种极强的压迫感。

    【一阶凶兽：铁甲獠猪】

    【介绍：拥有极强冲撞能力与防御能力，普通武器极难破防，猎杀可掉落兽核和优质凶兽肉】

    “这就是凶兽？”

    秦天微眯双眼，虽然他现在的身体素质已得到了全方位的增幅，可如果单打独斗面对如此怪物也绝对不是对手。

    “吼！”

    又是一道震耳的吼叫，野猪四只腿狠狠的蹬在地上，就打算径直朝着秦天扑杀而来。

    不过就在铁甲獠猪即将冲到秦天面前之时。

    嗖嗖嗖！！

    秦天耳边顿时响起数道刺耳破空声！

    下一秒。

    几支散发着凌厉能量波动的箭矢划破长空，从远处瞬间爆射而来。

    精准命中铁甲獠猪头部！

    噗嗤！

    刺耳的穿透声接连响起。

    铁甲獠猪那坚硬头骨竟然被瞬间贯穿。

    那巨大的身躯顿时在空中一僵，狂暴的攻势也骤然停下，庞大的身躯重重的砸在地上，发出一道闷响。

    四肢微微抽搐了一下，然后就彻底没有了生机。

    全场不到一秒！

    秒杀！

    绝对的碾压！

    秦天深吸了一口气，原本紧绷的身体缓缓放松下来，随后忍不住露出笑容道：“还好有穿云狙击塔。”

    不得不说刚刚那一瞬间，他还真有点压力。

    这玩意儿的压迫感确实远远超过普通野兽。

    而与此同时。

    系统提示音也迅速响起。

    【叮！穿云狙击塔成功击杀一阶凶兽铁甲獠猪！】
content_en:
roar! !

    A low and violent beast roar suddenly sounded from deep in the woods, and a huge black shadow was slowly pushing through the dense bushes, approaching him step by step.

    Qin Tian's originally calm expression suddenly condensed, and he quickly looked in the direction of the source of the sound.

    Although he had been mentally prepared for it, when he saw it clearly, Qin Tian couldn't help but feel a slight palpitation in his heart.

    It was a black wild boar, at least two meters tall.

    The whole body is covered with gray-black hair, like hard armor, and the muscles all over the body are even more exaggeratedly bulging.

    Four sharp fangs were exposed, dripping with sticky saliva, as if they were about to tear Qin Tian into pieces in the next moment.

    The most terrifying thing is the aura on it. Just standing there gives people a strong sense of oppression.

    [First-order ferocious beast: Iron-armored pig]

    [Introduction: It has extremely strong collision and defense capabilities. It is extremely difficult for ordinary weapons to break through the defense. Hunting can drop beast cores and high-quality ferocious beast meat]

    "Is this a vicious beast?"

    Qin Tian narrowed his eyes slightly. Although his physical fitness has been increased in all aspects, he is definitely no match against such a monster if he fights alone.

    "Roar!"

    There was another ear-splitting roar, and the wild boar kicked the ground with its four legs, intending to rush straight towards Qin Tian.

    But just when the armored pig was about to rush in front of Qin Tian.

    Whoosh whoosh! !

    Qin Tian's ears suddenly rang with several harsh sounds that broke through the air!

    The next second.

    Several arrows emitting sharp energy fluctuations pierced the sky and exploded from a distance instantly.

    Accurately hit the armored pig on the head!

    Poof!

    Harsh penetrating sounds sounded one after another.

    The armored pig's hard skull was penetrated instantly.

    The huge body suddenly froze in the air, and the violent offensive suddenly stopped. The huge body hit the ground heavily with a muffled sound.

    His limbs twitched slightly, and then completely lost their life.

    The whole scene takes less than one second!

    Instant kill!

    Absolute crushing!

    Qin Tian took a deep breath, and his tense body slowly relaxed. Then he couldn't help but smile and said, "Fortunately, there is a cloud-piercing sniper tower."

    I have to say that at that moment, he was really a little stressed.

    The sense of oppression of this thing is indeed far greater than that of ordinary beasts.

    And at the same time.

    The system prompt also sounded quickly.

    【bite! The Cloud-piercing sniper tower successfully killed the first-order ferocious beast, the iron-armored pig! 】
